title: Find Total Resistance
text: Total resistance in circuit = R + r = 5.5 + 0.5 = 6 Ω.

title: Calculate Current
text: I = ε/(R + r) = 12/6 = 2 A. This current flows through both the external and internal resistance.

title: Find Terminal Voltage
text: V = IR = (2)(5.5) = 11 V. Note: 1 V is 'lost' across the internal resistance (Ir = 2×0.5 = 1 V), so terminal voltage (11 V) is less than emf (12 V).
